_comment: Single source of truth for this project's EXPERTS. Do NOT hand-edit the generated regions in run-changeset.mjs / SKILL.md / policy.md / README.md / CLAUDE.md / agents/*.md — edit this file and run `node .claude/experts/manage.mjs sync`. Use the /add-expert and /disable-expert skills for the common cases. See .claude/experts/README.md.

experts.name: engineer
experts.focus: Simulation logic, systems/brains, DI/signals, core invariants. The default for logic work.
responsibilities: Headless simulation logic, systems, and per-entity brains
DI wiring in the composition root; cross-module comms via signals
Core invariants (determinism, execution order, input/validation boundaries)

experts.name: ui
experts.focus: React overlay; reads via the `GameApp` facade + signals; Tailwind static-vs-dynamic-style rule.
responsibilities: React overlay screens (menus / HUD / result) + reusable components
Reads simulation state only through the GameApp facade + signals
Tailwind static-value styling vs inline dynamic styling

experts.name: game-tuning
experts.focus: Balance/feel numbers only, no code changes. Routes to `haiku`.
responsibilities: Tuning-domain JSON values only (no code, no new keys)
Keeping related numbers coherent and inside sane ranges
Sanity-checking against the headless test/balance harness

experts.name: tech-artist
experts.routeHint: mostly src/view or the asset-pipeline module
experts.focus: Renderer + asset pipeline (slicer/registry/draw); view stays a pure reader; sheet sizes inferred, not hardcoded.
responsibilities: Read-only Canvas renderer: camera, background, entity draw, effects
Asset pipeline: sprite-sheet slicer, registry, animation player, swappable services
View stays a pure reader; sheet frame sizes inferred, never hardcoded

experts.name: artist
experts.focus: Search-before-generate; house diffusion; satisfy the project's asset-sheet contract. Broader than `icon-gen`; hands wiring to `tech-artist`.
responsibilities: Generate real image assets (sprite sheets, key art, character/skin art) via the house diffusion pipeline
Search before generating; satisfy the project's asset-slicing contract
Never ship placeholder art; hand renderer wiring to tech-artist

experts.name: product-owner
experts.consultFor: Scoping, prioritisation, MVP cut-lines, acceptance criteria (against `plans/` + `CLAUDE.md`).
responsibilities: Turn fuzzy requests into a prioritised, well-bounded list of changes
Write observable, testable acceptance criteria per change
Draw the MVP cut-line; name dependencies and sequencing

experts.name: game-designer
experts.consultFor: Mechanic / feel / loop design intent an execution expert then implements.
responsibilities: Turn intent into concrete mechanic specs (rules, states, feel)
Design against the core loop and identity; preserve hard invariants
Describe feel changes in player-observable terms

experts.name: qa
responsibilities: Typecheck / build / test the integrated result
Run the headless harness + determinism smoke where relevant
Report PASS/FAIL; never edit code

experts.name: merge-icon-author
responsibilities: Design + generate merge-item and generator icon ladders for the blade/bow/magic chains, enforcing the Three Cardinal Laws per-icon (clear differentiation, clear escalation, rising sophistication)
Run the sanctioned gen pipeline (reused FrogGame Fortis script with NO_REMBG + corner flood-fill; no local script; no backups) and self-review every chain on a contact sheet before wiring

Wire each tile/generator through the three registries — asset-registry manifest (assets.json), resolver defaults (src/data/assets.js), chain/generator presentation (config ui/chains + ui/generators) — never inlining a path or name
Gate the result on assets:validate + game-config:validate + build; defer drop-table tuning to game-tuning and renderer wiring to tech-artist
experts.routeHint: mostly the merge chains — merge-item + generator icon ladders and their wiring (assets/combatclean/merge, config chains + ui/generators presentation, merge entries in assets.json / src/data/assets.js)
experts.ownsLabel: the merge chains (`assets/combatclean/merge`, `config …/chains`, `config ui/generators`, `art/refs`) + the merge/gen entries in the shared `assets.json` / `src/data/assets.js`
experts.focus: Merge-item + generator icon ladders: design (Three Cardinal Laws), generate, chroma-key, self-review, and wire art/labels through the three registries. Not drop-table tuning (`game-tuning`) or the renderer (`tech-artist`).
